simulation_method: Event-ordered historical pool snapshots at owner confirmed tx block+1+lag; fixed BNB buys, proportional owner token sells with 10000 or 9975 constant product swap fee numerator; 1 BNB account capital; hypothetical fee stress and no persistent pool impact.
caveats: Pool reserve snapshots are exogenous; follower swaps not written to pool reserve state, this is NOT a fully executable price-impact replay
Pool choice fixed V2 and historical actual owner routing can use other contracts
Owner first transfer direction signals are retrospective observations; receiver can't necessarily see them with quote access at +1 block
Fee 0.25% and gas per action 0.0005 BNB are user-independent hypothetical stresses only
No out of sample, no human or external AI review yet
